title: Python Introduction
intro: Learn the basic ideas of Python Introduction in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: What is Python?
items.text: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language. It is designed to make code easy to read and write.

items.heading: Why is Python popular?
items.text: Python has simple, readable syntax and a large standard library. It is used in web development, automation, data work, AI and many other areas.

items.heading: Python source files
items.text: A normal Python program is saved with the .py extension. For example, a file can be named hello.py.

items.heading: Basic Python syntax
items.text: Python uses words, symbols and indentation to form valid statements. A simple statement can assign a value to a variable.

items.heading: Running Python code
items.text: The Python interpreter reads Python code and executes it. This lets you run a .py program from a Python installation.

items.heading: print() function
items.text: print() displays information on the screen. It is one of the first functions beginners use.

items.heading: Values in Python
items.text: Python works with values such as numbers, text, Boolean values and collections. A Boolean value can be True or False.

items.heading: Variables and functions
items.text: A Python program can use variables to store data and functions to group reusable instructions.

items.heading: Python is general-purpose
items.text: Python is not limited to one task. The same language can be used to automate repetitive work, build applications and process data.

items.heading: Python code is readable
items.text: Readable code is easier to understand, test and maintain. Python avoids much unnecessary punctuation, which keeps beginner programs clean.
